name: Crooked Ward

targets.description: an immobile surface you touch; the Sphere springs from that point

upcast.text: Concentration lasts up to 1 hour with a level 4 slot and up to 8 hours with a level 5 slot. With a level 6 or higher slot it needs no Concentration and lasts 24 hours.

summary: Touch a fixed surface: an unseen 30-ft Sphere where Aberrations, Fey, Fiends, Monstrosities and Undead have Disadvantage on checks and attacks and must save (Wis) or be Frightened.
text: You touch an immobile surface and mark a symbol that causes agony in twisted creatures. An Invisible Sphere of 30-foot radius springs out from the point you touch. Each Aberration, Fey, Fiend, Monstrosity or Undead in the Sphere has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. When such a creature enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: Concentration can last up to 1 hour with a level 4 slot or up to 8 hours with a level 5 slot; with a level 6 or higher slot the spell needs no Concentration and lasts 24 hours. Creatures of those types on your own side (an Ashborn, Deepborn, Graveborn or Relicborn hero) are affected too: the game warns when you cast it with one in the area.
